notes.title: BladeShield 1.11 is live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26890557/20b1efcc453a676da9f6f8435ee2b77bb4409062.png

Greetings BladeShield Wielders,

We have important information that must be brought to your attention.

The rogue A.I. ELLEN has been overheating, and her robot arsenal is now suffering from decreased performance (we made the game slightly easier in the beginning waves)

Additionally, the BladeShield units have received upgrades, and unleashing your epic energy blast is much simpler in the heat of battle (just click the trigger when it's charged)

notes.title: BladeShield 1.1 is live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26890557/0e3bfbb64aa98607c90674d166d4a6330fd3991e.pngGreetings!  We've just enhanced your robot destroying experience with the following changes:

    Fiery new power for your charged blade
    The insides of the robots and turrets have undergone major hardware upgrades
    Newly introduced EMP Blast ability! (This isn't new, but none of you realized it was there so we made it way easier to understand and use.  It's new to you)
    Improved the experience for new players to jump in and start playing immediately
    A couple gameplay fixes here and there
    It is now the best rated VR game* (*rated by my friend Steve who is currently #43 on the leaderboards)
